findings.summary: advisory: an $extensions that is not an object is coerced to {} and a mode override written that way vanishes with no error and no gate red — the one residual route that is silent at system level (probed: validate green, css:check green, 28/28 tests green)

advisory: a node holding both a $value and child tokens returns only itself, so the whole child subtree is dropped without a word — the last unhandled branch of the token/group classification; not live in the current file and caught downstream by design-tokens validate as [malformed-token-file], but the generator itself does not speak
advisory: String(node.$type) coerces, so $type: ["color"] passes the Map as "color"; harmless today (it projects as intended) but it is the one place the accepted set is wider than the table

advisory: two distinct token paths can kebab to the same custom property (space.4 vs space-4); both declarations are emitted and CSS last-wins, and the leaf-count guard counts lines rather than names so it cannot see it. No collision exists in the current file (verified)

advisory: blockOf slices to the first `}` after the selector, which is correct only while no declaration block contains a nested brace; a future nested at-rule would make it silently under-read the block it is asserting on
